mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, customerName VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(10, 2) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (id, customerName, amount, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{customerName}, #{amount}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, customerName AS customer_name, amount, status FROM orders ORDER BY id ASC
